findings.title: Preserve recorded logs when deriving a contextual test logger
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh TestLogger with independent log records. LoggerMiddleware now logs exclusively through logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so a TestLogger supplied to that middleware never records the completion message on its InfoLogs; the message is recorded on a temporary instance that the caller cannot access. This breaks assertions and observation of middleware logging through the provided test logger. Return the original logger or share the recording state with the contextual instance.
